method: Frozen v1 row-level numerical human efficacy definition. A row with at least one qualifying cited patient-efficacy passage is supported; model simulations and human cells in vitro do not qualify.

H16.name: Relatlimab
H16.rationale: One cited passage reports numerical pathological and radiographic response rates in patients receiving nivolumab plus relatlimab. The additional nonnumerical PFS passage alone would not qualify.

H18.name: Tirzepatide
H18.rationale: Cited passage reports respiration changes in human myotubes in vitro, not efficacy in human patients.

H18.name: survodutide
H18.rationale: Cited passage reports the numerical proportion of treated patients with a liver-fat-content reduction versus placebo.

H19.name: Sacituzumab Tirumotecan
H19.rationale: Cited passage describes a partitioned-survival cost-effectiveness simulation, not numerical observed human efficacy.
